scripts.install:all: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && cd services/data && uv sync --frozen
scripts.dev:data-api: cd services/data && uv run uvicorn liqi_data.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && cd services/data && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && cd services/data && uv run mypy src
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && cd services/data && uv run pytest
